data.title: 椎名真由理 · 铁道天桥上的盛夏回眸
data.description: 烈日灼灼的秋叶原总武线铁道天桥上，深蓝晴空下翻滚着巨型白积雨云。真由理双手按着便帽回首灿烂欢笑，浅蓝裙摆在风中如花绽放。
data.location: elevated urban pedestrian bridge over bustling railway tracks beneath towering summer clouds
data.action: turning back happily on footbridge, holding down her brimmed sun hat with both hands as train roars past below, radiant joyful smile
data.lighting: 盛夏明晃晃白日阳光直射
data.promptProse: Mayuri laughs radiantly on a pedestrian train bridge under towering summer clouds, holding down her sun hat as a breeze catches her blue dress.
data.animaCaption: Summer sunlight brightens her sweet smile as the breeze catches her hat and dress on the footbridge.
